name: AdCP 3.2 Content-Digest carries SHA-256 and sha-256 (uppercase dictionary key is not a case-insensitive synonym, content-digest covered)
spec_reference: #verifier-checklist-requests step 1 (RFC 9530 §2 Content-Digest is an RFC 8941 Dictionary; RFC 8941 §3.1.2 keys are lowercase only); AdCP 3.2 profile per #content-digest-and-proxy-compatibility and #adcp-rfc-9421-profile binary value encoding
$comment: 3.2-profile counterpart of negative/030-content-digest-key-case.json. AdCP 3.2 profile: the signature covers content-digest, binary values use RFC 8941 sf-binary (standard padded Base64), and the verifier advertises covers_content_digest='required'. Both members are the correct digest of the body in standard padded Base64, and the Signature is a valid Ed25519 signature over expected_signature_base, which carries the Content-Digest value exactly as sent, so the uppercase key is the only fault. Generated by scripts/generate-request-signing-profile-3.2-vectors.mjs from the test keys in keys.json; do not hand-edit.
